title: Xbox COO Helen Chiang Departs Microsoft
excerpt: Xbox's first chief operating officer, Helen Chiang, is leaving Microsoft after a tenure of 21 years with the company.
body_html:
Xbox is losing its first chief operating officer just months after the leadership position was established. According to an internal memo, Helen Chiang is departing Microsoft.

Chiang spent 21 years at Microsoft, which included leading the Minecraft franchise prior to her promotion to the Xbox chief operating officer role. The announcement of her departure marks a notable change in the gaming division's leadership structure following the recent creation of the COO position.
